tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App canvas behind everything; the stage's outer edge.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Window chrome, table headers, input wells (inputs sit on it inside cards).

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Side panes: file rail and inspector. One step off bg so panes read as furniture, not content.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, modals, the command palette.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Pills, chips, inactive controls, selected list rows, evidence chips.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Hover on surface-2 controls; nested wells inside cards.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines: card borders, pane dividers, table rules.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (buttons, inputs, segmented), separators inside the toolbar. Controls are also set apart by fill; never rely on this border alone.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and values, on bg, panel, surface and surface-2/3 (≥13:1 dark, ≥15:1 light, ≥6:1 night).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, uppercase micro-labels, inactive tabs. ≥5:1 on every surface in dark and light, ≥4.2:1 night.

tokens.name: text-dim
tokens.usage: Placeholders' icon, disabled controls, decorative separators. Fails 4.5:1 as text (3.0–3.6:1 dark): never use for text a person must read; the mocks' labels move to text-muted.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The amber. Primary action fill, active pill, selection, focus ring, the current filmstrip frame, the STF midtone knob. One amber element per region; it means 'this is on / do this'.

tokens.name: accent-on
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (10:1 dark, 6.3:1 light, 8:1 night).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind accent text: active pill/tab/chip, active toolbar button, modified header rows.

tokens.name: accent-fg
tokens.usage: Accent as text or icon on surfaces and accent-soft (light uses a deeper amber: #c98a0c is only 2.9:1 as text).

tokens.name: nebula-orange
tokens.usage: Fills and chart marks for supernova remnants, broadband/luminance, warnings chips' fill.

tokens.name: nebula-rose
tokens.usage: Fills and marks for emission nebulae and Hα, clipping overlay (highlights), red channel.

tokens.name: nebula-teal
tokens.usage: Fills and marks for OIII, 'derived' tags, informational state, 'online'.

tokens.name: orange-fg
tokens.usage: nebula-orange as text on surfaces and on its 14% tint.

tokens.name: rose-fg
tokens.usage: nebula-rose as text on surfaces and on its 14% tint (4.5:1 on surface-2 dark).

tokens.name: teal-fg
tokens.usage: nebula-teal as text: the DERIVED tag, info badges.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success fill and marks: confidence pill border, status dot 'good'.

tokens.name: ok-fg
tokens.usage: Success as text (confidence number, 'match').

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning dot, warning text and icon ('Δ 3.6 °C', 'FOCALLEN=0 used default'). Also text-safe in light.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Errors, blockers ('blocks calibration'), rejected status dot. Text-safe in every theme. Always paired with a word or icon: night mode has no red/green distinction.

tokens.name: stage-center
tokens.usage: Centre of the image stage's radial glow.

tokens.name: stage-edge
tokens.usage: Edge of the image stage's radial glow; images sit on this, never on surface.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: Marketing and empty-state heroes only. Never inside the app chrome.

styles.name: display-number
styles.usage: KPI tiles and the integration total. Tabular numbers.

styles.name: display-verdict
styles.usage: The verdict line on the Overview card; card titles that name the file.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Stacked files get an integration breakdown.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Card titles (12.5–14px), emphasis in running text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Sub-lines, list secondary text, footnotes. text-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase micro-labels above values and on pane headers. text-muted (not text-dim).

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Header keywords and values, CLI equivalents, terminal output.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Pixel HUD, kbd hints, confidence pill.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between rows in dense lists (file rail).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between toolbar buttons and inside segmented controls; toolbar padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Chip gaps, HUD rows, label-to-value gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap in controls; small stacks.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Grid gaps inside cards (label/value pairs).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in the inspector; card inner padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Pane padding; card inner padding (horizontal); stage insets for toolbar and HUD.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Modal and palette padding.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Section spacing in reports and full-page views.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Evidence chips, kbd, small inline tags.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, list rows, thumbnails (7–9px thumbs round to this), HUD boxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Verdict icon tile, menus. Nebulis' input/button radius.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Every card and KPI tile.

tokens.name: radius-window
tokens.usage: Windows, the command palette, the image when shown framed.

tokens.name: radius-modal
tokens.usage: Modals.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, pills, chips, tabs, the floating toolbar, confidence pill. Controls are pills.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: Window frame in screenshots/marketing only.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating layers: command palette, modals.

tokens.name: shadow-image
tokens.usage: The image on the stage when fitted.

tokens.name: shadow-focus-halo
tokens.usage: Soft halo around a field being edited, outside its accent border.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: All hover, press, tab and pill transitions (ease-out). Nothing slower in the chrome.

tokens.name: layout-rail
tokens.usage: File rail width.

tokens.name: layout-inspector
tokens.usage: Inspector width.

tokens.name: layout-titlebar
tokens.usage: Title bar height.

tokens.name: layout-filmstrip
tokens.usage: Filmstrip height (folders only).

tokens.name: layout-control
tokens.usage: Toolbar button and pill height; buttons 32px, inputs 34px.
